description: Hard constraints for the BTE Knowledge Graph. Specification only — enforcement is deferred to a future sprint.

constraints.name: No cyclic dependency
constraints.description: The directed subgraph formed by edges whose type participates_in_dependency_cycle_check MUST be a DAG. Cycles among FOUNDATIONAL_FOR and DEPENDS_ON are forbidden.
constraints.remediation: Remove or reclassify one edge in the cycle; prefer correcting academic dependency direction over weakening type semantics.

constraints.name: Unique Canonical Node
constraints.description: Each canonical concept MUST map to exactly one canonical Concept node in the graph. Duplicate nodes representing the same immutable record_id are forbidden.
constraints.remediation: Merge duplicates; retain the node whose record_id is authoritative.

constraints.name: Immutable Record ID
constraints.description: Once a node is bound to a Knowledge Record ID (KR-*), that record_id MUST NOT change for the lifetime of the node. Renames of display labels are allowed; ID remapping is not.
constraints.remediation: Create a new node only for a new concept; deprecate the old node via governance — never rewrite its ID.

constraints.name: No duplicate relationships
constraints.description: At most one edge may exist for the same (edge_type, source_node_id, target_node_id) triple. Duplicate relationship instances are forbidden even if edge_id values differ.
constraints.remediation: Keep a single edge; merge notes into that edge metadata.

notes: RELATED_TO and CONFLICTS_WITH may be stored as a single undirected edge or as a normalized bidirectional pair; uniqueness still applies to the logical triple.
These constraints are declarative. No graph engine, validator binary, or compiler hook is shipped in Sprint 3B.
